  "title": "Isolette Monitor — draft derived requirements, lines 101–200",
  "system_description": "The Monitor Temperature system receives sensed temperature and operator-selected alarm limits with validity status, and produces alarm control and monitor status. Within the selected window, the Manage Monitor Interface process and thread receive temperature and mode information, report monitor status and interface failure, and forward alarm limits when no interface failure exists. Process/thread structure, port connections, scheduling domain and periodic dispatch are source-defined implementation choices.
